[Unit]
Description=SkillEdge Clean Elite Live Capture
After=skilledge-stock-engine-api.service
Wants=skilledge-stock-engine-api.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine
EnvironmentFile=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine/.env.server
ExecStart=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine/.venv/bin/python ops/scripts/clean_elite_ledger.py --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 --initial-capital 50000 --risk-pct 0.01
User=skilledge
Group=skilledge

[Unit]
Description=Run SkillEdge Clean Elite Live Capture every 5 minutes

[Timer]
OnBootSec=2min
OnUnitActiveSec=5min
Persistent=true
Unit=skilledge-clean-elite-capture.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

[Unit]
Description=SkillEdge Daily AI Desk Runner
After=skilledge-stock-engine-api.service
Wants=skilledge-stock-engine-api.service

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine
EnvironmentFile=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine/.env.server
ExecStart=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine/.venv/bin/python run_daily_ai_desk.py --loop --interval-seconds 300 --start-kyiv 11:00 --end-kyiv 23:00
Restart=always
RestartSec=10
User=skilledge
Group=skilledge

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit]
Description=SkillEdge Engine Watchdog
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine
EnvironmentFile=-/opt/skilledge/stock-engine/.env.server
ExecStart=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine/.venv/bin/python /opt/skilledge/stock-engine/ops/scripts/engine_watchdog.py --public-url https://engine.upyourskills.site --auto-restart --alert
User=root
Group=root

[Unit]
Description=Run SkillEdge Engine Watchdog every 5 minutes

[Timer]
OnBootSec=2min
OnUnitActiveSec=5min
AccuracySec=30s
Persistent=true
Unit=skilledge-engine-watchdog.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

[Unit]
Description=SkillEdge Historical Learning Backfill Scheduler
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target skilledge-stock-engine-api.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine
EnvironmentFile=-/opt/skilledge/stock-engine/.env.server
ExecStart=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine/.venv/bin/python /opt/skilledge/stock-engine/run_historical_learning_backfill.py --symbols AAPL,NVDA,TSLA --intervals 5min --years-back 5 --max-days 5 --chunk-days 1 --max-jobs 1 --max-candidates 5000 --sync-supabase true
Nice=10

[Unit]
Description=Run SkillEdge Historical Learning Backfill Scheduler nightly

[Timer]
OnCalendar=Mon..Sat *-*-* 01:15:00
Persistent=true
RandomizedDelaySec=300
Unit=skilledge-historical-learning-backfill.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

[Unit]
Description=SkillEdge Nightly Self Learning Runner
After=skilledge-stock-engine-api.service
Wants=skilledge-stock-engine-api.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine
EnvironmentFile=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine/.env.server
ExecStart=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine/.venv/bin/python run_nightly_self_learning.py --lookback-days 3 --max-days 3 --min-closed 10
User=skilledge
Group=skilledge

[Unit]
Description=Run SkillEdge Nightly Self Learning at 23:35 Kyiv

[Timer]
OnCalendar=Mon..Fri 23:35
Persistent=true
Unit=skilledge-nightly-self-learning.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

[Unit]
Description=SkillEdge Post-Close Evidence Automation
After=skilledge-stock-engine-api.service
Wants=skilledge-stock-engine-api.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine
EnvironmentFile=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine/.env.server
ExecStart=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine/.venv/bin/python ops/scripts/post_close_evidence_automation.py --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 --limit 160 --max-best 5
ExecStartPost=/usr/bin/curl -fsS -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:8000/engine/outcomes/repair-stale-stock-open?dry_run=false&min_age_days=1&limit=5000"
ExecStartPost=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine/.venv/bin/python ops/scripts/setup_learning_report.py --db-path data/stock_engine.db --lookback-days 30 --min-closed 10 --initial-capital 50000 --risk-pct 0.005
ExecStartPost=/usr/bin/curl -fsS -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:8000/engine/investor-dashboard/run?publish=true"
User=skilledge
Group=skilledge

[Unit]
Description=Run SkillEdge Post-Close Evidence Automation at 23:12 Kyiv

[Timer]
OnCalendar=Mon..Fri 23:12
Persistent=true
Unit=skilledge-post-close-evidence.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

[Unit]
Description=SkillEdge Production Live-Day Readiness Check
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target skilledge-stock-engine-api.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine
EnvironmentFile=-/opt/skilledge/stock-engine/.env.server
ExecStart=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine/.venv/bin/python /opt/skilledge/stock-engine/ops/scripts/production_live_day_readiness.py --public-url https://engine.upyourskills.site --frontend-url https://www.upyourskills.site --alert-on-blocker
User=root
Group=root

[Unit]
Description=Run SkillEdge Production Live-Day Readiness Check before US premarket

[Timer]
OnCalendar=Mon..Fri 10:45:00
AccuracySec=60s
Persistent=true
Unit=skilledge-production-readiness.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

[Unit]
Description=SkillEdge Stock Engine API
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine
EnvironmentFile=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine/.env.server
ExecStart=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine/.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.api.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStartSec=60
KillSignal=SIGINT
User=skilledge
Group=skilledge

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit]
Description=SkillEdge Telegram Cache Consumer
After=skilledge-stock-engine-api.service
Wants=skilledge-stock-engine-api.service

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine
EnvironmentFile=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine/.env.server
Environment=TELEGRAM_CONSUMER_DRY_RUN=false
ExecStart=/opt/skilledge/stock-engine/.venv/bin/python telegram_cache_consumer.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=10
User=skilledge
Group=skilledge

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
